run_loading_benchmark: run the pybullet loading benchmark script to profile URDF and SDF model loading performance
load_urdf_models: load URDF models like plane, r2d2, and plate into the pybullet physics simulation
load_sdf_models: load SDF scene files such as kitchen environments into the pybullet simulation
profile_simulation_timings: start and stop state logging to profile pybullet simulation timing data to a JSON file
capture_camera_image: capture a camera image from the pybullet simulation viewport at a given resolution
